finding: BRISC binds all shapes; issue-bound: RD-ISSUE ~41ns per 32B DRAM read (1.3us for a_live=16), WR-XCHG-ISSUE ~20ns per 32B copy; barriers small (RD ~0.25us, final WR ~0.22us). Hoisting get_noc_addr per page: -1% (kept). Next lever: fewer transactions (grid-sync lamp, whole-band reads) or split copies across RISCs (exchange-owner lamp).

detail: per group of 32 input tiles: transpose_tile (bf8 unpack) into DEST 8 at a time, pack_untilize_dest<1,1>(8 rows) to bf16 RM -> [32 h x 1024 (c,w)] block; tilize<32> helper gathers output tile c=[h][w] (row exchange done by tilize unpacker) and packs bf8_b (shared exponent = group max). No dataflow row exchange needed.
